description:
Transfer an agent identity NFT to a new owner in the ERC-8004 identity registry. This clears the agent wallet association — run identity_set_wallet after if needed. Requires an unlocked wallet.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

fee.description: Fee preset ("low", "medium", "high") or micro-STX amount. Optional.

recipient.description: Stacks address of the new owner

sponsored.description: Use sponsored transaction relay so a relay service pays fees instead of your wallet. Requires SPONSOR_API_KEY env var or wallet-level sponsorApiKey.

name: identity_transfer
